lines.zh: 冻肉拼成的腿踩碎冰面，声音发闷
lines.en: Frozen-flesh legs crunch through the ice with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 它拖着半截身子，在雪坡上缓慢移动
lines.en: Dragging half a body, it works along the snowy slope.

lines.zh: 冻毛一簇簇掉落，又被风卷走
lines.en: Tufts of frozen fur drop off and are swept away.

lines.zh: 每走一步，冰壳就在关节处裂开
lines.en: Each step cracks the ice sheathing its joints.

lines.zh: 它沿着冰刺的方向往山顶爬
lines.en: It climbs toward the peak along the ice spikes.

lines.zh: 巨大的脚印里立刻渗满了雪水
lines.en: Its huge tracks fill at once with meltwater.

lines.zh: 它走得极慢，像在等什么追上
lines.en: It moves very slowly, as if waiting to be followed.

lines.zh: 冻僵的长鼻垂着，一路扫过雪地
lines.en: Its frozen trunk drags a line through the snow.

lines.zh: 风一吹，它身上的冻肉咔咔作响
lines.en: When the wind blows, the frozen meat on it creaks.

lines.zh: 它绕过冰川裂隙，脚步没有迟疑
lines.en: It skirts the glacier crevasse without a moment's pause.

lines.zh: 半副骨架撑着一层冻皮往前走
lines.en: Half a skeleton carries a shell of frozen hide.

lines.zh: 它在齐膝的雪里留下一串深坑
lines.en: It leaves a trail of deep pits in knee-high snow.

lines.zh: 它站着不动，冻毛上结满白霜
lines.en: Standing still, it wears a coat of white frost.

lines.zh: 冰峰的风从肋骨缝里穿过去
lines.en: Wind from the ice peak whistles between its ribs.

lines.zh: 那具残骸里传来极低的碾磨声
lines.en: A low grinding sound comes from inside the carcass.

lines.zh: 它的长鼻冻在雪面，像根石柱
lines.en: Its trunk is frozen to the snow like a stone post.

lines.zh: 眼窝里只有一层结了冰的暗红
lines.en: In its eye socket lies only a layer of frozen red.

lines.zh: 它抬头的动作卡在半空，迟迟不放
lines.en: It lifts its head halfway and holds it there.

lines.zh: 冻僵的耳朵缓慢扇动了一下
lines.en: One frozen ear gives a single slow twitch.

lines.zh: 它不动的时候更像一堆丢弃的肉
lines.en: When still, it looks like a heap of discarded meat.

lines.zh: 雪落进破开的胸腔，它也不抖
lines.en: Snow settles into its open chest, and it does not shiver.

lines.zh: 长牙上挂着一串不会融的冰珠
lines.en: A string of ice beads hangs from its tusk, never melting.

lines.zh: 山谷里只剩它粗重的呼吸声
lines.en: Only its heavy breathing remains in the valley.

lines.zh: 它在等风停，也在等别的东西
lines.en: It waits for the wind to stop, and for something else.

lines.zh: 冻毛下的肉偶尔抽动，像还活着
lines.en: The meat beneath the fur twitches as if still alive.

lines.zh: 它的影子压过冰面，比身体更长
lines.en: Its shadow stretches over the ice, longer than its body.

lines.zh: 它缓缓转过头，冰壳发出脆裂声
lines.en: It turns its head slowly, its ice shell cracking.

lines.zh: 那双冻住的眼睛一直跟着你
lines.en: Those frozen eyes follow you without moving.

lines.zh: 你在雪坡上，它已经看了很久
lines.en: You are on the slope, and it has watched a long while.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅空气，像认出了你的体温
lines.en: It sniffs the air as if recognizing your warmth.

lines.zh: 冰峰间它微微侧身，正对着你
lines.en: Among the peaks it angles its body toward you.

lines.zh: 它没有眨眼，因为眼睛早就冻住
lines.en: It cannot blink; its eyes froze long ago.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，它的长鼻就抬一寸
lines.en: Each move you make lifts its trunk an inch.

lines.zh: 风雪里它盯着你的方向不放开
lines.en: Through the blizzard it holds your direction.

lines.zh: 它低头看你，破开的胸腔露出骨头
lines.en: It looks down at you, its split chest showing bone.

lines.zh: 你身后的雪原，全都落在它眼里
lines.en: The whole snowfield behind you sits in its gaze.

lines.zh: 它嗅到了活物的气味，站住了
lines.en: It catches the scent of something living and stops.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的火把，像很不喜欢
lines.en: It fixes on your torch as if it dislikes it.

lines.zh: 那副残骸偏过头，关节咔地一响
lines.en: The carcass tilts its head with a crack of joints.

lines.zh: 它视线落到你脚下的雪，慢慢上移
lines.en: Its gaze drops to the snow at your feet, then climbs.

lines.zh: 它的长鼻垂到你面前，停住了。
lines.en: Its frozen trunk hangs before you and stops.

lines.zh: 雪光里它偏头，眼眶对着你。
lines.en: In the snowlight it tilts its head, sockets aimed at you.

lines.zh: 它把你和身后的雪坡一起看进去。
lines.en: It takes in you and the snow slope behind you at once.

lines.zh: 你举起灯，它的冰壳反了一下光。
lines.en: You raise a lamp, and its ice shell throws the light back.

lines.zh: 那副残骸晃了一下，冰壳掉下一角
lines.en: The carcass sways, and a corner of its ice shell falls.

lines.zh: 被击中处露出冻成块的内里
lines.en: The struck spot reveals meat frozen into a block.

lines.zh: 它慢慢回过身，像只是被打扰
lines.en: It turns back slowly, as though merely disturbed.

lines.zh: 伤口没有流血，只有冰屑落下
lines.en: No blood comes, only flecks of ice falling.

lines.zh: 你这一下让它的长鼻垂得更低
lines.en: Your hit makes its trunk hang even lower.

lines.zh: 它低头看伤处，久久没有抬起
lines.en: It looks down at the wound and does not look up.

lines.zh: 痛感似乎传到很远的地方才回来
lines.en: The pain seems to travel far before it returns.

lines.zh: 冻肉被削下一片，落在雪上没有声音
lines.en: A slice of frozen meat falls silently into the snow.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，冰面上拖出长痕
lines.en: It backs half a step, dragging a long mark on the ice.

lines.zh: 挨打之后，它的关节响得更频繁
lines.en: After the blow, its joints crack more often.

lines.zh: 冻肉不需要喂，它只盯着你
lines.en: Frozen meat needs no feeding; it just watches you.

lines.zh: 你手里的草料它看都不看一眼
lines.en: It does not even glance at the grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 任何食物都会冻在它的舌头上
lines.en: Any food would freeze solid on its tongue.

lines.zh: 它偏过头，对你的东西毫无兴趣
lines.en: It turns away, wholly uninterested in your offerings.

lines.zh: 你举起的胡萝卜只换来一阵沉默
lines.en: The carrot you raise earns only silence.

lines.zh: 饥饿对它早就没有意义了
lines.en: Hunger stopped meaning anything to it long ago.

lines.zh: 它闻了闻你的手，又慢慢转开
lines.en: It sniffs your hand and turns slowly away.

lines.zh: 递过去的东西掉在雪里，它没动
lines.en: What you offer drops in the snow, and it does not move.

lines.zh: 它要的不是食物，是你靠近
lines.en: What it wants is not food but your approach.

lines.zh: 你把肉放到冰上，它依旧站着
lines.en: You lay meat on the ice, and it keeps standing.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，只碰到一层冻硬的毛
lines.en: You bump into it and hit only crusted fur.

lines.zh: 它硬得像块冰岩，纹丝不动
lines.en: It feels like an ice boulder and does not budge.

lines.zh: 那半截身子擦过你，冷得刺骨
lines.en: That half body brushes past you, biting cold.

lines.zh: 它被你顶开半步，关节发出闷响
lines.en: You push it half a step, and its joints thud.

lines.zh: 冻毛上的霜蹭了你一身
lines.en: Frost from its fur rubs off onto you.

lines.zh: 它低下头，像在确认撞到了什么
lines.en: It lowers its head as if checking what hit it.

lines.zh: 撞击让一块冻肉从它身上掉下
lines.en: The bump knocks a chunk of frozen meat loose.

lines.zh: 它慢慢挪开，脚印里全是碎冰
lines.en: It shifts away, its tracks full of broken ice.

lines.zh: 骨骼相撞的声音在雪原上传得很远
lines.en: Bone knocking bone carries far across the snowfield.

lines.zh: 它挡在路口，只等你先让开
lines.en: It blocks the pass and waits for you to yield.

lines.zh: 冰原上只有它一头，找不到同类
lines.en: It is alone on the ice, with no kin to find.

lines.zh: 残骸不会求偶，只会一直站着
lines.en: A carcass does not court; it only stands.

lines.zh: 另一具骨架在远处，早就不会动了
lines.en: Another skeleton lies far off, long unmoving.

lines.zh: 它的长鼻擦过冰面，像在找谁
lines.en: Its trunk sweeps the ice as if searching for someone.

lines.zh: 冰峰之间没有回应它的声音
lines.en: Nothing among the peaks answers its call.

lines.zh: 它独自守着那片冻河，年年如此
lines.en: It keeps to the frozen river alone, year after year.

lines.zh: 同类的气味只在雪下很深的地方
lines.en: The scent of kin lies deep beneath the snow.

lines.zh: 它对着空谷抬了抬头，没有叫
lines.en: It lifts its head to the empty valley and stays silent.

lines.zh: 两只残骸若能相遇，也只会对峙
lines.en: Two such carcasses would only face each other.

lines.zh: 它不需要伴侣，只需要下一个猎物
lines.en: It needs no mate, only the next thing to hunt.

lines.zh: 掉在雪里的东西它从不捡起
lines.en: It never picks up anything dropped in the snow.

lines.zh: 那副蹄子只会踩，不会抓
lines.en: Those hooves only trample; they cannot grasp.

lines.zh: 闪亮的物品落在冰上，它踩了过去
lines.en: A shiny item lands on the ice, and it walks over it.

lines.zh: 它对掉落物的反应只是抬了抬头
lines.en: Its only response to a dropped item is a raised head.

lines.zh: 冻僵的舌头捡不起任何小东西
lines.en: A frozen tongue cannot lift anything small.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到腿边，它一脚踢开
lines.en: Something rolls to its leg, and it kicks it aside.

lines.zh: 它没有收集东西的本能
lines.en: Gathering has never been part of its nature.

lines.zh: 铁锭在它脚下，被雪很快埋住
lines.en: An iron ingot under its feet is quickly buried in snow.

lines.zh: 它看着掉落物，像看着不存在
lines.en: It looks at the dropped item as if it were not there.

lines.zh: 那具身体只带走雪和血
lines.en: That body carries away only snow and blood.

lines.zh: 它停住，长鼻直直指向你的方向
lines.en: It halts, its trunk pointing straight at you.

lines.zh: 冻住的眼睛里，映出你身后的火光
lines.en: Its frozen eye reflects the firelight behind you.

lines.zh: 雪坡上它忽然转向，朝你迈第一步
lines.en: On the slope it turns and takes its first step.

lines.zh: 风把气味送来，它认出你是活的
lines.en: The wind carries your scent, and it knows you live.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地锁定了你，一次也没移开
lines.en: It locks onto you slowly and never looks away.

lines.zh: 冰川上的碎石一动，它就转向那边
lines.en: A pebble shifts on the glacier, and it turns there.

lines.zh: 它跨过冻河，目标再清楚不过
lines.en: It crosses the frozen river with clear intent.

lines.zh: 那副残骸忽然不再犹豫
lines.en: The carcass suddenly stops hesitating.

lines.zh: 你听见关节连响三下，它在加速
lines.en: Three joint cracks in a row mean it is speeding up.

lines.zh: 它把你和雪原之间画了一条线
lines.en: It draws a line between you and the snowfield.

lines.zh: 长牙一低，整具残骸对准了你
lines.en: Tusks drop low, and the whole carcass aims at you.

lines.zh: 山谷回声里，它已经选定猎物
lines.en: In the valley's echo, it has already chosen its prey.

lines.zh: 它不管别的，只认你这一处热气
lines.en: It ignores everything but your single patch of warmth.

lines.zh: 目标确定后，它连呼吸都变慢了
lines.en: Once set, even its breathing slows down.

lines.zh: 它忽然不走了，长牙对着那个方向。
lines.en: It stops walking, tusks turned that way.

lines.zh: 雪雾散开的一瞬，它认出了你的热。
lines.en: The moment the snow mist parts, it finds your warmth.

lines.zh: 它一路跟着，冰壳在远处咔咔裂
lines.en: It follows, its ice shell cracking in the distance.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，它也不曾停一步
lines.en: However fast you run, it never once stops.

lines.zh: 长鼻贴着雪面，嗅着你留下的痕
lines.en: Its trunk glides over the snow, tracing your path.

lines.zh: 它绕过冰柱，路线始终对着你
lines.en: It rounds the ice pillars, always aimed at you.

lines.zh: 雪雾里那副轮廓越来越近
lines.en: That outline in the snow haze grows steadily nearer.

lines.zh: 它不喊，也不急，只是不停
lines.en: It does not call or hurry; it simply does not stop.

lines.zh: 冰刺刮开它的冻毛，它毫不在意
lines.en: Ice spikes tear its frozen fur, and it does not care.

lines.zh: 你躲在岩石后，它开始撞那片石头
lines.en: You hide behind rock, and it starts ramming that rock.

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在雪原上一声声压近
lines.en: Its footsteps press closer, one thud after another.

lines.zh: 它把你的脚印一寸寸踩平
lines.en: It flattens your footprints inch by inch.

lines.zh: 追久了，冻肉一块块从它身上掉
lines.en: As it hunts, chunks of frozen meat drop away.

lines.zh: 它只走直线，撞碎的冰层落在后面
lines.en: It walks a straight line, shattered ice left behind.

lines.zh: 你在坡顶回头，它正好抬头看你
lines.en: You glance back from the ridge, and it looks up.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的脚印，一步步踩过去
lines.en: It eyes your prints and steps on each one.

lines.zh: 你钻进冰缝，它用头去顶那层冰。
lines.en: You slip into a crevasse; it drives its head at the ice.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸在雪里越来越白。
lines.en: Its breath grows whiter in the snow.

lines.zh: 你跑不动了，它还在慢慢加速。
lines.en: You're out of run, and it is still slowly gaining.

lines.zh: 它绕过冰刺，速度没有变。
lines.en: It rounds the ice spikes without changing pace.

lines.zh: 长牙横扫过来，带着一层冰碴
lines.en: Its tusk sweeps across, trailing ice shards.

lines.zh: 冻硬的鼻子抽在你肩上，沉重而冷
lines.en: The frozen trunk lashes your shoulder, heavy and cold.

lines.zh: 它整个身子撞上来，像一堵冰墙
lines.en: It slams into you like a wall of ice.

lines.zh: 碎冰随着这一击溅了满地
lines.en: Broken ice sprays across the ground from the blow.

lines.zh: 象牙顶过来，你被推得连退数步
lines.en: The tusks shove you back several steps.

lines.zh: 它抬蹄踩下，雪面立刻陷出坑
lines.en: It raises a hoof, and the snow collapses beneath it.

lines.zh: 这一撞让它自己的肩骨裂了一声
lines.en: The hit cracks its own shoulder bone audibly.

lines.zh: 冻毛扫过你的脸，带着刺骨的寒气
lines.en: Frozen fur sweeps your face with bitter cold.

lines.zh: 它不收力，撞完继续往前推
lines.en: It never eases off; the shove keeps pushing forward.

lines.zh: 长牙擦着你的护甲，刮下白霜
lines.en: A tusk scrapes your armor and peels off frost.

lines.zh: 它把头压低，用额骨狠狠顶你
lines.en: It drops its head and rams you with its brow.

lines.zh: 一击之后，它身上的冻肉又掉一块
lines.en: After one blow, another piece of frozen meat falls.

lines.zh: 它挥鼻的动作慢，落点却很准
lines.en: Its trunk swings slowly but lands with precision.

lines.zh: 你退开后，它立在原地大声喘气
lines.en: As you retreat, it stands there breathing heavily.

lines.zh: 它撞碎冰面，冰碴跟着一起砸下。
lines.en: It shatters the ice sheet, and the shards come down too.

lines.zh: 这一下它自己也停不住，滑了半步。
lines.en: The blow carries it on; it slides half a step.

lines.zh: 冰峰裂开，一具冻僵的巨兽站起来
lines.en: The ice peak splits, and a frozen beast rises.

lines.zh: 雪堆下伸出半截长牙，然后是头
lines.en: Half a tusk emerges from the drift, then the head.

lines.zh: 冻河裂口里，冻肉一块块拼了起来
lines.en: In a cracked frozen river, chunks of meat assemble.

lines.zh: 它从冰刺丛中站起，霜从背上滑落
lines.en: It stands among the ice spikes, frost sliding off.

lines.zh: 风雪停下的一瞬，它出现在坡上
lines.en: The blizzard pauses, and it appears on the slope.

lines.zh: 那具残骸像一直就在那里，只是刚动
lines.en: The carcass seems always to have been there, only now moving.

lines.zh: 山谷深处传来骨头拼合的闷响
lines.en: Deep in the valley comes the thud of bone meeting bone.

lines.zh: 冰层下透出一片暗红，慢慢撑起
lines.en: A dark red patch shows through the ice and slowly rises.

lines.zh: 它睁眼时，冰面上多了一道裂
lines.en: When it opens its eyes, a crack spreads on the ice.

lines.zh: 罕见的一个雪夜，它从冻土里坐起
lines.en: On a rare snowy night, it sits up from the frozen earth.

lines.zh: 冻毛先动，然后整副骨架被撑开
lines.en: The fur moves first, then the whole frame is lifted.

lines.zh: 它站起时，冰刺林全被震得发抖
lines.en: As it rises, the whole ice-spike grove shivers.

lines.zh: 一条结冰的长鼻从雪里探出
lines.en: A frozen trunk pokes up out of the snow.

lines.zh: 这具残骸终于记起该怎么走路
lines.en: The carcass finally remembers how to walk.

lines.zh: 冰原上裂开一道口，它从那下面来。
lines.en: A crack opens in the ice field, and it comes up from below.

lines.zh: 这具残骸从冻土里被顶了出来。
lines.en: The carcass is pushed up out of the frozen ground.

lines.zh: 它落地时没有声音，只有冰在响。
lines.en: It lands without a sound; only the ice rings.

lines.zh: 冰刺林里多了个能走的东西。
lines.en: There is something in the ice spike forest that walks now.

lines.zh: 火一近，它表面的冰壳迅速化成水
lines.en: Near flame, the ice on its surface melts fast.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，它的一部分散在了雪里
lines.en: Falling from a height, part of it scatters in the snow.

lines.zh: 水渗进冻肉，它的动作沉了下来
lines.en: Water seeps into frozen flesh, and its movement sinks.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀走它半边身体，它还在走
lines.en: The blast tears away half its body, and it keeps walking.

lines.zh: 箭插在冻肉上，尾羽一直在抖
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the frozen meat, fletching trembling.

lines.zh: 咒力让它身上的冰发出细碎的光
lines.en: Magic makes the ice on its body glitter faintly.

lines.zh: 没有猎物，身上的冻肉开始剥落
lines.en: With no prey, the frozen meat starts peeling away.

lines.zh: 雷电劈中冰峰，它浑身亮了一瞬
lines.en: Lightning hits the peak, and it lights up briefly.

lines.zh: 虚空里，冻肉与冻毛各自散开
lines.en: In the void, frozen meat and fur drift apart.
